data.narrative:
Ephemeris Net is a seed-stage Space & Aerospace company founded by Dennis Fong and Nicolas Brown that has raised $3M to date. The sector comp universe consists of 6 public companies (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) and 8 private peers including Starcloud, SpaceX, Rocket Lab, ICEYE, and Sierra Space.

Of the three valuation methods assessed, only Stage-Progression proved applicable. This method uses the $3M total raised as a proxy for seed-stage valuation and applies a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical of seed-to-next-stage progression, yielding an implied valuation of $8M. Peer-Median analysis could not be executed: while 14 same-sector peers exist, the narrow filters for same-stage, adjacent-stage, and similar-tier comparables yielded insufficient datapoints (fewer than 3), making a reliable median unreliable. Public-Comp Anchoring was not applicable because target revenue data is not on file; the sector P/S median across public comps is 25.3x, but cannot be applied without Ephemeris Net's revenue figure.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $6M (low) to $9M (high), with a median of $8M. This range is derived from a single method and therefore carries material uncertainty. Key limitations include the absence of comparable private transactions at seed stage in this sector and lack of revenue disclosure, both of which constrain triangulation and increase reliance on stage-based progression methodology.
